Elaine C.: Heads-up: Candidate Priya K scheduled 3:00pm PST tomorrow. Need a scribe, debrief owner, and a 10m buffer between panels. Can someone confirm coverage? Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/priya-k

Sam P.: I can scribe the 3pm slot. @Maria G. — can you take debrief ownership?

Maria G.: I can own debrief. Quick ask — hiring manager wants system-design weight bumped to 30% for this hire. Is that okay? Also need Zoom room A reserved.

Sam P.: Sounds fine. Elaine, should I update the scorecard weights in the template or do you want People Ops to?

Elaine C.: Please update, Sam. Use this quick snippet for Greenhouse/scorecard: `Scorecard: coding 40, design 30, collaboration 20, rubric_notes 10`. Also lock a 10m buffer slot after the interview for debrief.

recruiting-bot: Candidate materials uploaded to /interviews/PriyaK and calendar invite created (zoom://room-A).

Maria G.: Done — I updated the debrief doc with the hiring manager's priorities. Sam: do you have remote whiteboard access for the coding problem?

Sam P.: Got it — whiteboard link: https://miro.com/priayk-3pm. I'll scribe and start the debrief doc during the buffer.

People Ops: Noted — will publish the post-interview checklist and confirm Zoom room A reservation.

Elaine C.: :thumbsup: Great, thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here.
